images.attempt: original attempt 1; owner colour edit attempt 1

images.edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: existing square children's science storybook page; Image 1 is the edit target.
Primary request: Change only the two children's garment colours. Recolour the older girl's entire pink floral dress to a lilac/violet floral dress, keeping the floral pattern and her cream cardigan unchanged. Recolour the younger boy's entire blue-and-white striped T-shirt to green-and-white stripes; keep his blue shorts unchanged.
Constraints: Preserve the exact composition, crop, poses, faces, facial expressions, hair, anatomy, hand placement, Vanilla the papillon, rain, garden, room, lighting, watercolour/paper-cut style, textures, and every other pixel-level visual detail as closely as possible. No leftover pink patches anywhere on the girl's dress and no leftover blue stripes anywhere on the boy's shirt. Do not recolour the girl's cardigan, shoes, skin, flowers, background, or the boy's shorts. Exactly 2 arms, 2 legs, and 2 feet per child. No text, no watermark, no added or removed objects.

images.name: rain-lands
images.prompt: One connected hillside cross-section with tree, grass, bare soil, roof and road; rain arrows go down into soil and downslope along roof and road; no text or uphill flow.

images.name: soil-sponge
images.prompt: Grass-and-soil cutaway with downward infiltration arrows, darker wet upper zone, pale dry lower zone and a separate sponge analogy; no pool or text.

images.name: full-sponge
images.prompt: Equal-rain paired cutaways: partly dry soil accepts water; dark saturated soil ponds a thin layer while one narrow arrow still moves down; full dripping sponge beside right panel.

images.name: runoff
images.prompt: Gentle high-left to low-right grassy slope; thin surface rivulets descend and join into the lowest roadside gutter; no underground or uphill arrows.

images.name: drains
images.prompt: Street cutaway with road runoff into curb inlet, connected catch chamber and enclosed drain pipe continuing right; separate manhole; continuous arrows and no text.

images.name: canals-to-river
images.prompt: Connected bird's-eye street inlet to underground pipe to narrow canal to wider river to calm sea; increasing widths and one-way downstream arrows; no gaps or labels.

images.name: sun-takes-water
images.prompt: Object-only sunny after-rain garden: shallow shrinking puddle and wet leaves feed upward translucent arrows and vapour dots into one small cloud; no downward rain or steam.

images.name: storage
images.prompt: Three rain-linked scenes: downspout into covered tank; shallow pond with two buffalo on bank; upstream reservoir behind small dam with designed downstream outlet.

images.name: one-journey-map
images.attempt: generated plate attempts 1–2 plus deterministic recomposition
images.prompt: One cloud with exactly four branches: soak, flow, wait/evaporate and store; one connected bottom river to sea and one later storage outlet; icons and arrows only.
images.composition_method: reading-app/tools/build-rain-book2-art.py crops the accepted generated base into four fixed vignettes, places them in an exact 2x2 grid, draws exactly four branch arrows, joins the flow vignette to the single river/sea, and draws one storage outlet into that river.

images.name: closing
images.attempt: original attempt 1; owner colour edit attempt 1
images.prompt: Exact cover cast walking safely beside a shallow rivulet with exactly two paper boats and a calm reservoir/dam in the distance; preserve identities/outfits; no danger or text.
